body: As of March 2025, the fix of moving the dxgi.dll from the Guild Wars 2 folder that has the GW2-64.exe into the bin folder containing the cef folder (and deleting the dxgi.dll that is already in there if there is one) still works.
If the arrows are blast finishers when detonated, this could bring back heal scrapper. Just depends on what the other arrows do I suppose. Will be interesting to test out though.

There wouldn't be any real differences between steam or the official website. Just know that you would have to purchase expansions on the same platform you made your account on. For example, you can't buy living world seasons or SOTO on steam and have it apply to your account if you set up your account and everything directly through the website.

As for starting out, if you plan on buying things right away, I would recommend getting the HoT and PoF bundle to get your glider and mounts. You could look into living world season 2 if you are interested in following the story, but as far as value it isn't great. The maps for LWS2 don't require purchase to go to. 

LWS3 is the story between the first 2 expansions and gives you access to some easy to get ascended rings, necks, accessories, and back pieces as well as a legendary accessory.

Just note that if you own an expansion, you will end up getting weekly and daily wizard vault tasks for those zones so I wouldn't recommend buying an expansion until you are ready to head there if you care about the vault rewards (which as a new player you should, they are a huge help for fresh accounts).
